text: Databases help us store and organise information. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, while NoSQL databases store data in more flexible ways, such as documents. To get information from a database, we write queries. Data modeling means planning how data is structured before we build the database. Indexes make searches faster because they help the database find data quickly. Choosing the right type of database and designing it well is important for good performance.
